description: This source file defines a Java class 'UnsupportedCommandExceptionMapper' that implements an exception mapper to handle 'UnsupportedCommandException' exceptions. It maps these exceptions into HTTP responses with appropriate error messages and status codes (HTTP 400 Bad Request), for use in a REST API context within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: UnsupportedCommandExceptionMapper
classes.description: A JAX-RS exception mapper class that converts 'UnsupportedCommandException' into an HTTP 400 Bad Request response, encapsulating error details in a JSON structure.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts an 'UnsupportedCommandException' into an HTTP Response with a detailed error message and status code.
